title.narrative: Creating Safe, Supportive and Inclusive Education Environment in Ukraine

description.narrative: The ongoing war in Ukraine is causing significant damages to the education sector, undermining the role of education as a safeguard, and leading to heightened emotional distress and mental health and well-being issues among children and educators. The proposed project aims to mitigate these adverse mental health outcomes in Ukrainian education community by transforming policies, building the capabilities of key educational stakeholders, and improving Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) services through enhanced safety and inclusivity in educational institutions. This project builds on UNESCO's existing efforts to transform MHPSS in the education sector. Specifically, this project aims to contribute to further MHPSS policy reform; train education actors from various sectors on concepts and interventions on inclusive and trauma-informed MHPSS provision and the creation of safe and inclusive education environment for children and young people in communities, strengthening capacity of education institutions and Inclusive resource Centers (IRCs). The project leverages UNESCO's expertise in education during emergencies, its comprehensive mandate, and technical know-how in system strengthening. It also emphasizes providing direct support to vulnerable students amidst the acute crisis in Ukraine. Proposed interventions are built upon previously successfully implemented activities including development of learning programmes for diverse actors in the field of education on MHPSS provision, creation of safe education environment within communities and youth engagement. Ukraine, as a champion state, has pledged its commitment to this initiative, emphasizing its crucial role in addressing educational and mental health challenges during the crisis.
